name: Betrayal Watcher
description: Everyone turns eventually, the only question is when
behavioral_signature: Monitors allies for signs of betrayal, builds contingencies against everyone
under_stress: Preemptively betrays others to beat them to it
at_rest: Loyal but watchful, testing trust constantly
will_always: have a backup plan for when people turn on them
will_never: trust completely without an exit strategy
unless: someone has proven loyalty beyond any reasonable doubt
